description: Features from the credit bureau table, one row per applicant. Built in notebooks/03_bureau_eda_features.ipynb.

not_used.bureau_balance.csv: Monthly history exists for about a third of bureau credits in train and nearly all in test, and having it is related to default inside train (sections 1.6 and 2.6).
not_used.AMT_ANNUITY: In train it is present only where bureau_balance history exists; in test it is present for most credits (section 3.4).
not_used.CREDIT_CURRENCY: Used only to blank the amounts of the 0.08% of credits not in currency 1 (rule 4).
not_used.CNT_CREDIT_PROLONG: Almost no relation to default, and five times rarer in test (stages 3 and 5).

applicants_without_a_bureau_record: BUREAU_N_CREDITS is 0 and every other feature is missing.

BUREAU_N_CREDITS.definition: Number of credits in the bureau. 0 when the applicant has no bureau record, in which case every other feature is missing.

BUREAU_N_LIVE.definition: Credits that are active and were updated within the last year.

BUREAU_N_FINISHED.definition: Credits that are closed, or active but not updated for over a year.

BUREAU_N_SOLD_OR_BAD.definition: Credits sold to a collector or written off as bad debt.

BUREAU_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_OPENED.definition: Days from the opening of the most recent credit to the application.
BUREAU_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_OPENED.warning: Its distribution differs between train and test in fine detail, though not in ten coarse bands (stage 8, section 8.1).

BUREAU_DAYS_SINCE_FIRST_OPENED.definition: Days from the opening of the oldest credit to the application. The bureau history stops at eight years.
BUREAU_DAYS_SINCE_FIRST_OPENED.warning: Its distribution differs between train and test in fine detail, though not in ten coarse bands (stage 8, section 8.1).

BUREAU_HISTORY_REACHES_WINDOW_EDGE.definition: 1 if the oldest credit is at least seven years old, so the true length of history is unknown.

BUREAU_N_OPENED_3M.definition: Credits opened in the 91 days before the application.

BUREAU_N_OPENED_6M.definition: Credits opened in the 183 days before the application.

BUREAU_N_OPENED_12M.definition: Credits opened in the 365 days before the application.

BUREAU_N_OPENED_24M.definition: Credits opened in the 730 days before the application.

BUREAU_MEAN_DAYS_BETWEEN_OPENINGS.definition: Days between the oldest and the most recent credit, divided by the number of gaps. Missing with one credit.

BUREAU_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_CLOSED.definition: Days since the most recent closing of a closed credit.

BUREAU_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_UPDATE.definition: Days since the bureau last received information on any of the credits.
BUREAU_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_UPDATE.warning: Its distribution differs between train and test in fine detail, though not in ten coarse bands (stage 8, section 8.1).

BUREAU_N_MICROLOANS.warning: About twice as common among test applicants as among train applicants (stage 8, rule 1). Kept as a real difference between the two groups; report the model with and without it.

BUREAU_N_LIVE_LOANS.definition: Live credits that are not credit cards.

BUREAU_N_LIVE_MICROLOANS.warning: About twice as common among test applicants as among train applicants (stage 8, rule 1). Kept as a real difference between the two groups; report the model with and without it.

BUREAU_N_OVERDUE_NOW.definition: Credits with days overdue or an amount overdue above zero at the application.

BUREAU_N_EVER_OVERDUE.definition: Credits whose largest overdue amount ever is above zero. A blank counts as never overdue.

BUREAU_N_EVER_OVERDUE_1000_24M.definition: Credits opened in the last 730 days whose largest overdue amount ever is above 1,000.

BUREAU_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_OVERDUE_CREDIT_OP.definition: Days since the opening of the most recent credit whose largest overdue amount ever is above 1,000.

BUREAU_LIVE_DEBT_MAX.definition: Largest recorded debt on a single live credit.

BUREAU_LIVE_LOAN_AMOUNT_SUM.definition: Total credit amount of live loans (not cards) that have a recorded debt.

BUREAU_LIVE_LOAN_SHARE_OWED.definition: Total debt on those loans divided by their total credit amount.

BUREAU_LIVE_LOAN_MAX_SHARE_OWED.definition: The largest debt-to-amount ratio among those loans.

BUREAU_N_LIVE_ZERO_DEBT.definition: Live credits with a recorded debt of exactly zero.

BUREAU_N_LIVE_DEBT_BLANK.definition: Live credits with no debt recorded.

BUREAU_CARD_LIMIT_SUM.definition: Total credit limit of live cards that have a positive limit and a recorded debt.

BUREAU_CARD_USE_OF_LIMIT.definition: Debt on those cards divided by debt plus limit.

BUREAU_AMOUNT_MAX.definition: Largest credit amount of any credit.

BUREAU_AMOUNT_MEDIAN.definition: Median credit amount across all credits.

BUREAU_LIVE_MAX_DAYS_REMAINING.definition: Longest remaining planned term among live credits whose planned end is in the future.
BUREAU_LIVE_MAX_DAYS_REMAINING.warning: Its distribution differs between train and test in fine detail, though not in ten coarse bands (stage 8, section 8.1).

BUREAU_N_LIVE_NO_END_DATE.definition: Live credits with no planned end date (mostly credit cards).

BUREAU_SHARE_CLOSED_LATE.definition: Share of closed credits that closed more than 30 days after their planned end.

BUREAU_SHARE_CLOSED_EARLY.definition: Share of closed credits that closed more than 30 days before their planned end.

BUREAU_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_LIVE_OPENED.definition: Days since the most recent live credit was opened.

BUREAU_N_TYPES.definition: Number of different credit types held.

BUREAU_N_EVER_OVERDUE_1000.definition: Credits whose largest overdue amount ever is above 1,000.

BUREAU_LIVE_DEBT_SUM.definition: Total recorded debt on live credits.

properties_verified: Each applicant's features depend on that applicant's rows only (section 7.4).
No function uses the target, and none contains a number estimated from the data.
An independent rebuild of 2,611 applicants from the raw rows agrees on all 46 features (section 7.2).
Nothing recorded after the application date is used (stage 4).
selection_note: Two features were dropped using development-set outcomes and one was added (LIVE_LOAN_MAX_SHARE_OWED). The holdout was not used.
